narr: Scattered Storms congealed into a severe line of storms during the evening and overnight, producing wind gusts up to 70 mph, hail to ping pong ball size, and several brief funnel clouds. Rainfall amounts up to 6 inches led to some flash flooding over rural areas.
ev: Multiple county roads damaged due to washouts from flash flooding overnight. Delayed report. Time estimated from radar.
